scope: General native ASS spike-reduction paths; console only, no playback
baseline: Previous accepted event/layout stable snapshots, unchanged x64 owned and Win32 borrowed group-key policies

scheduling.builds: Serial /m:1 /nr:false on CPU 7 at Normal priority; no build/timing overlap

burst_cohort.criterion: At least 1000 ASS events start since preceding source frame; selected from source timestamps before timing comparison

preparation_cost: Synchronous lookahead is inside RenderEx and all full-render timings, including blank requests; parse_ms alone excludes it. No startup prepass or worker.

budgets.lookahead_largest_nonpreemptible_unit: One Unicode source event of at most 8192 characters; deadline can be exceeded by that unit

limitations: Offline frame times/counts do not measure playback drops
Inclusive phases overlap; lookahead is outside the parse phase and inside complete render
One CPU and Above Normal priority do not eliminate frequency/PC interference
Remaining spikes and compatibility-sensitive paths are recorded in the report

rejected_band_storage_composition.timings: Nested phases overlap; thread CPU clock has coarse per-frame resolution

independent_bursts_x64.timings: Nested phases overlap; thread CPU clock has coarse per-frame resolution

packet_delivery_model_x64.scope: Model of chronologically delivered Add/segment updates plus RenderEx, including initial active packets; source read/style setup excluded
packet_delivery_model_x64.comparison: Same optimized native build, lookahead 0 versus 4000 us; not an old-renderer speed comparison or observed playback delivery
packet_delivery_model_x64.steady_scope: Exclude only the first independently initialized model request; keep all later activation/font/raster spikes. This is not an actual pause/resume test. User permits one isolated pause-resume drop.
